say:6:1311101001:1.text: It's finally over... How did the Hierophant become like that?

say:11:1311101006:1.text: I struggle to understand... The Hierophant was revered by both the temple and the community. He had no reason to betray the Divine Light.

say:16:1311101011:1.text: Even I have never heard of that in two thousand years.
